descriptions.tsonnet_b37_open_80189574: Opens the array reference at +88 of a nested record for writing without growing it (element unit 4) and returns its data; when that array held no elements it reopens the same reference with the element count of the array at +96, or returns null if that is also empty. Locks an unshared store of the right size in place, otherwise calls the original reserve helper. Field meanings are inferred; the helper has not been tested.
descriptions.tsonnet_b37_open_8018963c: Same operation as the +88 variant on the array reference at +68, with element unit 8 (fallback length from the array at +96). Field meanings are inferred; the helper has not been tested.
descriptions.tsonnet_b37_open_80189760: Same operation as the +88 variant on the array reference at +84, with element unit 4 (fallback length from the array at +96). Field meanings are inferred; the helper has not been tested.
